alerts.reason: Black Knight’s reported revenue growth eased from 10.72% in March to 9.19% in June, leaving room for September to stay above -5%. Mortgage originations were already falling as rates rose after a prolonged refinancing boom (C). I forecast that lower origination volumes against elevated prior-year volumes will pull December-quarter revenue down at least 5% year over year.

nLIGHT’s June revenue fell 11.99% year over year during a roughly two-month Shanghai plant closure (D). I forecast a September rebound above -5% as that temporary disruption eases, followed by a December decline of at least 5%. Lower China product sales, declining development revenue and customers delaying capital spending support the renewed decline (A, B).

Matson’s consolidated revenue growth slowed from 63.74% in March to 44.14% in June. Ocean Transportation revenue still rose 53.6%, but Hawaii container volume fell 1.5% as retail demand weakened (A–C). I forecast September growth above -5% and a December decline of at least 5% if the weakness in retail freight spreads beyond Hawaii.
